text.member_unwired: {path}: no workflow runs it — it cannot fail a pull request
text.member_untested: {path}: no self-test beside it (add {dir}/test_{stem}.sh, or exempt it)
text.test_unwired: {path}: no workflow runs it — the suite passes locally and gates nothing
text.test_bare: {path}: a workflow runs it without tools/checks/run_suite.sh
text.loop_bare: a workflow loop over self-tests runs them without tools/checks/run_suite.sh: {loop}
text.summary: check_guards_are_wired: {n} unreachable or untested guard(s), or a bare self-test loop.
text.ok: check_guards_are_wired: OK — every guard is wired to a workflow and self-tested.
